name: Rocky Mountain FMC Championship 2026

venue.name: Multiple Locations
venue.details: See Venues tab for information about locations and registration fees.

information:
This competition is the FMC portion of the 2026 [Rocky Mountain Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RockyMountainChampionship2026). As such, the only event will be 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.

Please also note that this competition will be held simultaneously at multiple locations across the region. See the Venues tab for information about locations and registration fees.

Due to the multi-locational nature of this competition, the registration process is significantly different from the usual process in the Rocky Mountain region. Please see the Registration Requirements on this page for more information.
